wnba.Headline: Fever-Sky is most-watched regular-season WNBA game since 1997
wnba.Description: The Fever-Sky game Sunday averaged 3.31 million viewers on NBC and Peacock to make it the most-watched regular-season WNBA game since the league's inaugural season in 1997.

wnba.Headline: Unrivaled adding more travel in 2027 amid soaring valuation
wnba.Description: Unrivaled will expand to more road trips outside Miami in 2027 as the league announced a valuation of $650 million and that the players equity pool is up 550% since 2024.

wnba.Headline: Opals captain Sami Whitcomb to miss FIBA World Cup
wnba.Description: The Australian Opals' FIBA World Cup campaign has suffered a major blow with captain Sami Whitcomb withdrawing from the tournament which tips off next week in Germany.

wnba.Headline: Phoenix hosts Washington on home slide
wnba.Description: Washington Mystics (23-15, 11-5 Eastern Conference) at Phoenix Mercury (13-25, 8-11 Western Conference)

wnba.Headline: WNBA playoffs 2026: Which teams have clinched berths?
wnba.Description: Minnesota, Las Vegas, Golden State, Indiana, Atlanta, New York, Washington and Dallas are headed to the playoffs.

wnba.Headline: Mystics beat the Mercury 94-84 for 2nd-most regular-season victories in franchise history
wnba.Description: — Sonia Citron had 19 points and nine assists, Kiki Iriafen added 18 points and 10 rebounds for her 17th double-double of the season, and the Washington Mystics beat the Phoenix Mercury 94-84 on Tuesday night.

wnba.Headline: Phoenix Mercury vs. Washington Mystics - Game Highlights
wnba.Description: Watch the Game Highlights from Phoenix Mercury vs. Washington Mystics, 08/25/2026

wnba.Headline: Dallas Wings secure final WNBA playoff berth with 23rd win
wnba.Description: The Dallas Wings claimed the eighth and final WNBA playoff spot Tuesday with their 96-78 victory over the Portland Fire at College Park Center, sending star guard Paige Bueckers, the 2025 No. 1 pick, to the postseason for the first time.

wnba.Headline: Wings beat the Fire 96-78 to clinch the final WNBA playoff spot
wnba.Description: — Paige Bueckers had 22 points and 11 assists, Jessica Shepard added 21 points, nine rebounds and six assists, and the Dallas Wings beat the Portland Fire 96-78 on Tuesday night to clinch the final WNBA playoff spot.

wnba.Headline: Dallas Wings vs. Fire - Game Highlights
wnba.Description: Watch the Game Highlights from Dallas Wings vs. Fire, 08/25/2026

wnba.Headline: Aaliyah Edwards scores a career-high 26 points as the Sun beat the Sky 87-81
wnba.Description: — Aaliyah Edwards scored a career-high 26 points to go with 10 rebounds, and Diamond Miller added 21 points as the Connecticut Sun beat the Chicago Sky 87-81 on Tuesday night.

wnba.Headline: Connecticut Sun vs. Chicago Sky - Game Highlights
wnba.Description: Watch the Game Highlights from Connecticut Sun vs. Chicago Sky, 08/25/2026

wnba.Headline: Sky ban Kanter Freedom from arena after clash with Cloud
wnba.Description: Chicago Sky owner Michael Alter said Enes Kanter Freedom was banned from Wintrust Arena after showing he had the potential to be a threat when he was removed for a verbal altercation with a Sky player during a game Sunday.

wnba.Headline: WNBA Power Rankings: Valkyries make statement with win over Lynx
wnba.Description: Golden State got its first win over Minnesota in franchise history as it moves closer to hosting playoff games.

wnba.Headline: Seattle faces Toronto, aims to end 3-game skid
wnba.Description: Toronto Tempo (11-26, 5-11 Eastern Conference) at Seattle Storm (7-31, 1-17 Western Conference)

wnba.Headline: Angel Reese sets WNBA single-game, season rebounding records
wnba.Description: Angel Reese set a WNBA record with 26 rebounds in the Dream's 78-71 win over the Sparks on Monday, pushing her past the league's season record in the same game.

wnba.Headline: Angel Reese breaks WNBA single-game and season rebounding records as Dream beat Sparks 78-71
wnba.Description: — Angel Reese broke the WNBA single-game rebounding record with 26 while also breaking the league's season record for rebounds as the Atlanta Dream beat the Los Angeles Sparks 78-71 on Monday night.

wnba.Description: The Lynx remain favorites to win the WNBA championship, while the Fever are making a move on the oddsboard.
